turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Excuse me, is this seat free?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Yes, go ahead. Are you going all the way to the coast?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Yes, to the last stop. First time there. Have you been?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Yes, I've been there a few times. Last summer I stayed for a week with my family.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I love it. The beaches are lovely, and the fish restaurants are amazing. But it gets really busy in August.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Exactly. Are you going on holiday?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Not really. I'm meeting my fiancée's family for the first time, so I'm a bit nervous.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Oh, don't worry. I'm sure they'll like you. Just be yourself, and maybe bring them something sweet from the city.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Good idea! I'm going to the buffet. Want anything?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: No, thanks, I'm fine. Good luck this weekend!
